resources.string: We value your privacy. Our app is designed to provide an educational experience without collecting any personal information. If data is collected, it is solely to improve app functionality and enhance your user experience. All data, if any, is handled responsibly and securely, in compliance with Google Play policies. No data is shared with third parties without your explicit consent. For detailed information, please contact us at:

Welcome to 9th Class Science Notes! Our mission is to make learning easy and accessible for students. We provide clear, concise notes and study materials to help you excel in your science subjects. We’re dedicated to supporting students in their academic journey and committed to educational success.

By using 9th Class Science Notes, you agree to abide by our terms of service, which promote responsible usage of the content. Unauthorized distribution or reproduction of content is prohibited. Our app is intended for personal and educational use only. For questions or concerns about these terms, feel free to contact us at:

Our app displays ads to support development and keep it free for users. These ads may be personalized based on your general preferences, but we do not store or share any personal data. For details on how ads work and to adjust your preferences, please visit our Privacy Policy page.
